items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And we got to go through the Monkees and the Beatles and Presley and all of that came in.

ctx.x: Yeah, before the Beatles took over. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
